Reads the PRD, extracts milestone structure, creates a TodoWrite tracking loop, and iterates through implementation using Agent, Workflow, and direct tool execution. Triggers: "start", "go", "ship it", "start the PRD", "start building", "start coding", "start development", "let's begin", "let's get started", "execute the spec", "implement this PRD", "build from the spec", "break down the PRD", "turn spec into tasks", "begin phase", "where are we", "status", "status update", "what's the status", "show me the plan", "what's the plan", "resume", "continue", "keep going", "try again", "retry", "redo", "skip", "skip this milestone", or referencing a numbered milestone (T0, M1, phase 1, milestone 2) within a project that has a PRD or .memory/project.md. Also triggers on: "progress", "what's next", "next milestone".
skills.description_zh:
Universal harness that turns any PRD, spec, or requirements document into directly executed development tasks enforced via Claude Code tool calls — not /goal text generation, but real Bash-gated TDD loops.

Core mechanism: Adversarial evaluation. Instead of checkbox compliance ("coverage ≥ 80%"), the harness tries to break things. The BREAK step deletes implementation and demands tests fail with AssertionError — not ImportError. GREEN includes GENERALIZE: a second test with different inputs must pass without changing code. No hardcoded thresholds — coverage floors and retry ceilings derive from baseline measurements.

Flow: PRE-FLIGHT classifies projects (greenfield/brownfield/resume) → INGEST reads the PRD, measures baseline, generates CLAUDE.md and .memory/project.md → ROUTE manages milestone state machine → EXECUTE runs adversarial TDD (RED → GREEN+GENERALIZE → BREAK → REFACTOR → bash-gated GATE) → LOOP. Each step is blocked on exit code evidence. No evidence → no progress.

Optional GitNexus integration for brownfield projects: pre-change impact analysis on existing symbols, post-commit architecture drift detection. Advisory only — tests remain authoritative.

Progressive disclosure: SKILL.md (~540 lines) with 5 reference files loaded on demand. Shell translation table for PowerShell/Bash compatibility. Human escalation rules: only ask when genuinely blocked, never for routine decisions.

6 files, zero hardcoded numbers, one principle: if you can't delete the code and watch the test die for the right reason, you haven't proven anything.
skills.name: prd-to-action

skills.description:
🎬 给我一个话题，还你三套拿得出手的爆款骨架

【核心原理】小策做四件事：
1. 内核提炼：一个话题拆出三套差异化思路（认知冲突/价值对比/身份代入）
2. 框架匹配：七库里的爆款框架秒套用，附带段落结构与篇幅适配
3. 素材调用：从知识库挑最匹配的案例/金句/钩子，全部标注来源
4. 骨架输出：标准逻辑批注大纲直接交付小晶，不用再过一遍

不写文字——只搭结构。缺的不是文笔，是方向。

与普通AI写作的区别：普通AI一上来就铺句子，方向跑偏了再改成本极高；小策先把方向定死，每段标好功能/情绪/钩子，写的时候直接照着走，水到渠成。

【触发】当用户以"小策"称呼、要求做文案策划/顶层设计/搭大纲/提炼内核/匹配框架，或输入格式为"小策，以XX为话题，长文/中篇/短视频"时使用本技能

【适用场景】做IP号每天大量选题的创作者 / 写文案卡壳方向跑偏 / 有素材库不知怎么用 / 想批量产出同风格内容

【工作流】话题 → 3次检索 → 3套内核 → 框架匹配 → 素材调用 → 情绪钩子 → 大纲

【三件套位置】中游：小库（素材）→ 小策（骨架）→ 小晶（成文）

📌 必读：先装Obsidian建七库，用小库入库至少10篇爆款素材

与普通AI写作的区别：普通AI一上来就铺句子，方向跑偏了再改成本极高；小策先把方向定死，每段标好功能/情绪/钩子，写的时候直接照着走，水到渠成。

【触发】当用户以"小策"称呼、要求做文案策划/顶层设计/搭大纲/提炼内核/匹配框架，或输入格式为"小策，以XX为话题，长文/中篇/短视频"时使用本技能

【适用场景】做IP号每天大量选题的创作者 / 写文案卡壳方向跑偏 / 有素材库不知怎么用 / 想批量产出同风格内容

【工作流】话题 → 3次检索 → 3套内核 → 框架匹配 → 素材调用 → 情绪钩子 → 大纲

【三件套位置】中游：小库（素材）→ 小策（骨架）→ 小晶（成文）
